summary: Write CD-ROM exactly that way, use 'CD-ROM drive' for the drive, and 'CD-ROMs' as the plural.
questions: How should CD-ROM be spelled in documentation?

answer_card.title: CD-ROM spelling
answer_card.answer_md: Use **CD-ROM** (not cdrom, CD-Rom, CDROM). Say "CD-ROM drive" for the drive; plural is "CD-ROMs".
